lines: What!? Your sister has been kidnapped by a slave trader!?
A spirited woman's voice echoed through a street in Tokyo Kingdom.
How despicable... Unforgivable! I will save her, I swear on my name as Devildom Knight Lena!
She was called Lena, a Devildom Knight of Nomad, which was an organization with substantial power in the underground world.
But at present, she would say that she was merely a Devildom Knight who had come to this city while traveling to hone her skills.
Eh? No, that's fine, no need to thank me. It is a Devildom Knight's duty to help those in need.
Oppressing the weak is beyond the pale! ...is what Lady Ingrid always said.
Ah, no, don't mind me! So where did those kidnappers go...?
Ahh, thank you so much! I think my master will also be pleased. I'm so glad we reached out to Gosha for help.
No, no, we just did our job. And you, don't go getting lost again.
The chubby, angry-looking cat meowed in a hoarse voice as I handed it over to the man.
The man in black, who seemed to be a secret service agent, got into an all-black car and left while skillfully soothing the cat with some food.
Sheesh, it's finally over. What a tedious mission... Ow ow ow...
Oh, Fuma-chan, your face! You've got a scratch!
Woah, she's right, you're bleeding from your forehead. You were in quite a tussle with that cat, weren't you, Fuma?
Yeah. That was a crazy street cat.
Today's mission had been to search for a cat that had escaped in the City of Darkness at the request of a certain high-ranking government official.
This official was known to be a cat lover and had brought his cat with him on an incognito visit to this city. The cat had then escaped from his arms and ran away.
The panicked official had secretly asked Headmistress Asagi for help, and the mission to look for the cat had been handed down to us.
But looking for a lost cat... Heberybody is really turning into a bunch of odd-jobbers.
I guess once in a while it's not too bad. If we had to fight for our lives every mission, our bodies wouldn't be able to keep up.
Mmhmm, I like these more laid-back missions!
We started walking back home while chatting.
Hmmm... a pet. It makes me feel like I want a pet again too.
Oh, Shikanosuke-chan, you had a pet?
It wasn't mine. But my granny used to have a dog a long time ago.
But he was already quite old. He died when I was little and I really missed him.
Yeah, for sure. For a while, you can't concentrate on anything else, right?
As was typical of the countryside, there were many people keeping pets in the plentiful spacious houses of Gosha Village.
For Taimanin who earned a living putting their lives on the line, innocent animals were an important presence, allowing them to relax.
Fuma-chan, do you not have any pets? Even though your house is so big?
I mean, I want to have one. But Tokiko says no. She says I won't take proper care of it.
That's because you think everything is a pain in the ass. And in the end, Tokiko-san would be the one taking care of it. She can see right through you.
That's not true! I'm even taking good care of the Sakura I found...
Wha-, that's awful. You're talking about Sakura-chan like she's a pet.
N-No, that's not what I meant! You could say it was more of an analogy.
If I felt like it, even I could at least take care of a pet. ...Hmm? What's that?
I caught sight of a group of large-bodied men making a ruckus in a little nook of the street.
Ohh!? So this is where you've been!!
You've got some nerve running away from us, hehe...
It seemed like a couple of rough-looking Orcs were giving someone a hard time. Not an unusual sight in this city.
Are those Orcs shaking someone down? Let's just walk past before we get caught up in it.
I said as I began to walk faster.
Wait, Fuma-chan, isn't that a child they're picking on?
As I stared intently, I could in fact see some small, trembling arms from between the legs of the Orcs.
H-Hey, isn't this the time for justice!? We can't just pretend we didn't see anything when a child is in danger...!
Shikanosuke's legs were totally making their getaway from the Orcs, but he puffed out his chest with everything he had.
Yeah. Let's see if we can help.
We nodded to each other, quickly decided on a plan, and approached the Orcs from behind.
Ummm, hey guys, do you have a minute?
And the moment the Orcs turned around―
Without delay, Hebiko squirted octopus ink in the Orcs' faces.
It stinks! I can't see anything!!!
And from behind the struggling Orcs, who were shaking their heads in confusion upon suddenly being blinded―
Shikanosuke and I gave them a good whack on the backs of their heads with rocks and scrap iron that had been lying around the area.
That was enough to give even these orcs a concussion, and they collapsed to the ground.
Hehe, I'm getting used to this.
Alright, let's get out of here while we have the chance!!
I grabbed the hand of the child who had been quivering behind the Orcs and started to run away.
We weren't sure just how far we had run. We had made it out of the main road and dashed into a narrow side street.
Phew. We should be safe here!
Are you hurt? Let's quickly get you back to your parents―
And as I looked back at the child again―
What I had taken by the hand, thinking it was a child, was a strange creature with the head of a crow and the body of a girl.
Eeeek... things got too intense to notice before, but is it wearing a mask!? Or is it a Demon!?
When she said Demon, I was reminded of a description of the races of the Devildom that I had read a long time ago.
A crow's head and a child's body... is that maybe a child of the Yatagarasu tribe!?
The Yatagarasu tribe. It was said that as children they had the head of a crow, and when they became adults they would start to resemble humans.
Yeah. They look strange, but they mean no harm to humans, they form bonds easily, and they don't make much noise, so you can even keep them as house pets.
Keep something like this as a pet!?
Who knows...? I guess you just have to think of it like a penguin or something...
You can't easily keep penguins as pets either, you know.
We were somewhat keeping our distance as we spoke in soft voices.
Hey, you two, why are you standing over there? It's kind of cute if you take a closer look! See, who's a good girl?
Hebiko seemed to have already gotten used to it and was petting its shiny black head.
It might be cute, but still be careful. They're docile, but apparently they have a powerful venom in their beaks.
If you accidentally get pricked, the proteins in your body will transform and you'll get boxified.
Whoooa!!? It's super dangerous then, isn't it!?
Not sure what "boxified" means, but it does sound dangerous.
It should be fine as long as we don't attack it. Anyway, what should we do...
The Yatagarasu child was just staring at us blankly.
It's no use, I have no idea what it might be thinking. But the first step to winning over an animal is... food.
I rummaged through my bag and took out a few cookies. They were ones Saika had made and given to me.
Once the Yatagarasu child realized that the cookies were food, it began wolfing them down.
It looks happy! It must've been hungry.
After finishing the cookies, the Yatagarasu child latched onto me and cooed.
H-Hey, hey. I don't have any more.
Ehehe. Seems like it likes you, Fuma-chan. So how about you take care of it?
Good idea. Fuma, you said you wanted a pet, didn't you?
Huh!? I mean, I guess you can't say it's not an animal, but...
Strangely, once someone brought up the idea, it started to look kind of cute.
But even this thing must have a family or an owner somewhere, right? Don't you?
I-I guess we won't be able to understand each other...
(But wait...? Speaking of Yatagarasu, I feel like I've seen this torso somewhere before...?)
Ahhh!! Found you, you villains!! If you thought you could get away fwom my Yatagarasu powers, you were mistaken!!
She was one half of the mischievous duo that had caused me trouble in the past.
How dare you kidnap my little sister, Fuma! I knew you were a cweep! You're under awwest!
Here, have this cookie and calm down.
It wasn't clear what her misunderstanding was, but the cookie was able to make the rambunctious Minasaki quiet down right away.
So? What's this? Kidnapped your sister? Me?
Yeah! My sister over there was kidnapped by an undergwound gwoup of slave twaders.
So I quickly searched for her. You know of my power, wight?
With Minasaki's "Yatagarasu power," she could locate anyone she had met once.
It wasn't precise though, and apparently worked in a "think it's over there" kind of way.
That's it? Then you should be thankful. Because we just rescued her from a group of Orcs.
That's wubbish. I know it's you who's behind all of this.
Hmph. You're the one spouting rubbish without any proof.
The name of the gwoup is the Black Scarves. They chose that name because their boss is always wearing a black scarf.
Your black scarf! That's unshakeable pwoof you're the boss of the Black Scarves!
I felt my neck. There was indeed a black scarf there.
No, that's different! I got this from Saika... and besides, there are plenty of guys wearing black scarves around here!
Tut tut tut. How foolish of you to think that that is the only pwoof I have. They say there is a huge scar on the boss's forehead.
That scar on your forehead, isn't that the scar they speak of!
Minasaki pointed directly at my forehead. And she was right, there was a mark from where the cat had scratched me.
No! This is where the cat―
Two pieces of evidence. Adding to that how you've tweated my fwiends and me so far, this pwoves that you are guilty!
Fuma, you need to know when to give up.
Ahaha, just joking. Still, it looks like that's the girl that was kidnapped.
Hebiko pointed at the Yatagarasu child. Standing next to Minasaki, they did kind of look like siblings.
If you still don't admit it, I guess we have to beat it out of you...
In response to Minasaki's voice, a shadow slowly appeared from the back of the alley.
Hiding in the darkness and kidnapping young girls; I was wondering what villain could do such a thing, but you're still a youngster...
I'm sure you have your reasons. But still, I cannot look the other way on this villainous act!
I, Devildom Knight Lena, will punish you without mercy!!
...The girl unsheathed her long sword and struck a pose with a smug look on her face.
(Damn, once again things are getting complicated...)
Lena. The slightly ditzy Devildom Knight who had helped us by coincidence in Yomihara only a few days ago.
(H-, hmmm. Don't tell me she forgot...)
No matter, whether we've met or not, villains must be brought to justice!
Crap! No choice, get ready for battle!
